standard: ITTF Statutes 2026, Laws of Table Tennis 2.3.1: spherical ball, diameter 40 mm. Fixed nominal size, so no range midpoint applies.
construction: White matte ABS sphere with a faint equatorial join: smoothly recessed by at most 0.03 mm. A very subtle baked surface normal gives matte plastic texture. No text, stars, logos or stamps.
approximation: The ball is an opaque outer shell; wall thickness, mass, bounce and interior are not modeled. The two molded hemispheres are represented by one continuous sphere with a shallow join. The groove is deliberately subtle.
